title: Off-by-one in synchronized_hop_channel returns out-of-bounds channel
description:
In python/src/lichen/link/channel.py, synchronized_hop_channel() uses:
  n = max(n_channels, 3)
  return 1 + (h % n)

This returns channels 1 to n (inclusive). With n_channels=64, returns 1-64, but valid channels are 0-63.

Compare to hash-based path which correctly uses:
  n = max(n_channels - 1, 1)
  ch = 1 + (h % n)

Fix: Change line 82 to:
  n = max(n_channels - 1, 2)

This ensures channel < n_channels while preserving the minimum 3-channel spreading requirement.

Impact: GNSS-synchronized hopping can select invalid channel numbers, causing undefined behavior in radio configuration.

Tags: codereview, correctness, channel
